messages:
rachel: Postmortem follow-up: turning recurring KV-eviction pattern items into tests. Proposal: 10-day sprint with three deliverables - regression suite (promptset), deterministic load replay, and a chaos drill runbook. Need owners + quick handoff.

tom: I can take the regression suite. Will curate failing prompts + edge cases and add to the regression runner. ETA Thu EOD.

vijay: I'll do the load replay. Prefer sanitized incident replay for fidelity; will fallback to synthetic if PII blocks us. Need infra ticket for ephemeral runner. ETA Wed noon.

leah: I'll own the chaos drill plan & runbook (KV eviction + fallback verification). Plan: staging canary + explicit rollback checklist. Draft ready by Fri.

ci-bot: New ticket created: "PMT-tests-sprint" assigned to rachel - https://boards.redwood.internal/pm/222 (automated)

rachel: Nice. Quick decisions: recorded replay preferred, but capture token-size distribution and session inter-arrival times if synthetic. Regression gate proposal: if KV-eviction >0.1% OR model-fallback >0.5% in 24h -> auto-block deployment and page oncall.

tom: I'll include gating metrics in the regression suite metadata and add automated checks to the pipeline.

vijay: Infra note: will need approx 30m of sustained high-VU replay and metrics retention for 48h. @rachel Ill raise the infra req once you confirm traffic profile.

rachel: OK I'll post the sanitized trace samples and a short token distribution summary by EOD. Standups Mon/Wed/Fri 10:30 for the sprint.
